The Flood.text: The abilities of Light Host cards in Choirs do not work this Day, including abilities that work on their own. The cards still count toward Alignment. Neutral cards are unaffected.
The Flood.why: Ruling confirmed November 16: every ability of that colour is off for the Day, automatic ones included (was: only abilities a player chooses to activate)

Let There Be Light.text: The abilities of Dark Host cards in Choirs do not work this Day, including abilities that work on their own. The cards still count toward Alignment. Neutral cards are unaffected.
Let There Be Light.why: Ruling confirmed November 16, mirroring The Flood

Casting Lots.text: Each player secretly predicts the Tide during the Unveiling: Light, Dark, or Neutral. At the Reaping, a correct call gains 1 Glory (2 for Neutral); a wrong call loses 1.
Casting Lots.why: Wording: pays At the Reaping, after the Tide is set (was "In the Evening")
